title: Code of practice for pattern making by using expanded polystyrene material
clause_1_scope: This standard describes the code of practice for pattern making and moulding by using expanded polystyrene material.
clause_3_terminology: Code of practice for pattern making by using expanded polystyrene material

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
